text:
Mira Patel: Quick check — planning to roll the feature-flag `torch-encoder-v2` tomorrow. Proposed bucketing: 5% early canary (internal), 15% wider experiment, 80% baseline. Need confirmation on bucketing key, quorum rules and stop/rollback criteria. Will start the 5% ramp first.

Samir Chen: What metric are we optimizing in the AB run? scoring accuracy (NDCG@10) or downstream click-through? also need to know the sampling window size for significance.

Mira Patel: Primary metric = NDCG@10 (eval harness), secondary = CTR (prod event). Sampling window: 24h by default but we can set rolling 6h windows for faster feedback on major regressions.

Leo Park: For audience hashing use `user_id` as the bucketing key (consistent with other experiments). Seed should be `2026-03-torchv2` to avoid collisions with previous splits. Quorum rule proposal: require 3 consecutive windows (6h each) with p>0.95 in favor before expanding to next slice; symmetric stop if p>0.95 against. Also add an early stop if effect size > 3% negative for primary metric.

Dena Alvarez: Add performance guardrails: if p99 latency increases by > 40ms OR error rate (5xx) +0.5% absolute over baseline, trigger immediate rollback. Also we should mute non-critical alerts for the 5% slice to avoid noise.

rollout-bot: Preflight checks complete: feature flag exists in ff-service, client SDK versions >= 2.7 detected in all envs, canary group config validated. Load test smoke: OK.

Mira Patel: Putting config snippet here for ops to sanity-check before I open the rollout PR:
```json
{ "flag": "torch-encoder-v2",
  "bucketing": { "key": "user_id", "seed": "2026-03-torchv2", "slices": [5,15,80] },
  "windows": { "evaluation_window_hours": 6, "quorum_windows_required": 3 },
  "metrics": { "primary": "ndcg@10", "secondary": ["ctr", "p99_latency", "5xx_rate"] },
  "stop_rules": [
    "p_value_against_baseline >= 0.95 for 3 consecutive windows -> expand",
    "p_value_against_baseline >= 0.95 against baseline for 1 window -> rollback",
    "p99_latency_increase_ms > 40 -> immediate rollback",
    "5xx_rate_absolute_increase >= 0.005 -> immediate rollback"
  ]
}
```

Samir Chen: I'll take the PR review (ping me with #4219). Quick note: let's include a dashboard row for rolling false-positive checks (entropy & overlap across slices).

Leo Park: Also add a neutral-exposure control to monitor allocation drift (10k user sample via hashed key) — prevents stash skew.

Dena Alvarez: I'll create the alerts: `exp.torchv2.p99_regression`, `exp.torchv2.5xx_surge`, `exp.torchv2.ndcg_drop`. Will set notification to eng-platform and oncall.

Mira Patel: Great. Starting 5% canary at 09:00 UTC tomorrow if no objections. I'll post the PR and tag the rollout ticket. :thumbsup:

Samir Chen: LGTM.

Leo Park: 👍

rollout-bot: Rollout scheduled: 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z for flag torch-encoder-v2 (5% -> 15% -> 80%). Automated monitoring hooks enabled.
